title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
Senior IT Specialist
Job Number: 26-01110

Want to be part of the Energy Industry? ECLARO is looking for a Senior IT Specialist for our client in New York, NY.

ECLARO's client operates one of the world's largest energy delivery systems, constantly at the forefront of innovations in developing technology. If you’re up to the challenge, then take a chance at this rewarding opportunity!

Position Overview:
  • Cybersecurity Engineer
  • Seeking a highly motivated candidate who demonstrates strong commitment to operational excellence, possesses technical proficiency in the deployment and or management of cybersecurity technologies such as but not limited to Trend Micro Antivirus, RSA SecureID, and Splunk.
  • The ideal consultant is well organized, detail-oriented, flexible to handle multiple assignments and meet deadlines with safety mind set.
  • This individual must also exercise good judgment and render sound business decisions.
  • The consultant should possess strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to produce design and procedural documentation.
  • Must be able to provide off-hour, on-call support as needed to support cybersecurity systems.

Responsibilities:
  • Work with others to implement new deployments of cybersecurity technologies such as CyberArk, Tenable, and other products.
  • Additionally assist other upgrade efforts on existing infrastructure equipment to support applications and cyber security growth.
  • Create documentation and procedures for day to day and major tasks as needed.
  • Determine and propose suggested architecture for system deployments.
  • Communicate and work with vendors and internal stakeholders on deployment of technology.
  • Configure and setup systems.
  • Create documentation and train others on the use of the new systems.
  • Patch and maintain technology.

Required Skills:
  • Managed Splunk Enterprise Security.
  • TrendMicro Anti-Virus

If hired, you will enjoy the following ECLARO Benefits:
  • 401k Retirement Savings Plan administered by Merrill Lynch
  • Commuter Check Pretax Commuter Benefits
  • Eligibility to purchase Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance through ECLARO

title: Supply Chain - UX Researcher
description:
Supply Chain - UX Researcher
Job Number: 26-01109
 
Be part of a company that delivers life-changing healthcare solutions. ECLARO is looking for a Supply Chain - UX Researcher for our client in New Brunswick, NJ. 
 
ECLARO’s client is a leader in the Biopharmaceutical Industry, providing quality, innovative, and affordable medicines that make a difference in the lives of patients all over the world. If you’re up to the challenge, then take a chance at this rewarding opportunity!
 
Position Overview:
  • This role blends experience strategy, hands‐on user research, and workflow analysis, with practical design execution.
  • Work closely with product owners, scientists, IT, and other cross-functional partners to identify requirements and translate user and business needs into intuitive, scalable designs.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Plan and lead user research activities, including user interviews, stakeholder interviews, workflow walk‐throughs, and usability testing
  • Synthesize research findings into clear insights and actionable recommendations, and present them to cross‐functional stakeholders
  • Map complex workflows and translate user needs into clear requirements, concepts, and UX strategies
  • Contribute to interaction design and UI design efforts, creating low‐ to high‐fidelity designs in Figma as appropriate for the project stage
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Data, and Product partners to ensure designs are feasible, scalable, and aligned with technical constraints
  • Support projects end‐to‐end, often acting as the sole UX resource on individual initiatives
 
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in any related field.
  • Experience in UX research, UX design, service design, or a related field
  • Strong workflow mapping, systems thinking, and requirements‐gathering skills
  • Experience with AI-enabled tools, data/analytics platforms, or modeling/automation workflows is highly desirable.
  • Experience with user research methods to iterate and validate designs.
  • Experience collaborating closely with cross-functional team members and stakeholders; Ability to work independently and manage ambiguous problem spaces
  • Proficiency with Figma
  • A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design thinking, interaction design, shipped work simplifying domain complexity into intuitive user experiences or similar.
 
Pay Rate: $75.79-$80.38/Hour
 
If hired, you will enjoy the following ECLARO Benefits:
  • 401k Retirement Savings Plan administered by Merrill Lynch
  • Commuter Check Pretax Commuter Benefits
  • Eligibility to purchase Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance through ECLARO

title: Program Manager
description:
Program Manager
Job Number: 26-00276

 
Want to be part of the Energy Industry? ECLARO is looking for a Program Manager for our client in White Plains, NY. 
 
ECLARO's Client is America's largest state power organization and is a national leader in energy efficiency and clean energy technology. If you’re up to the challenge, then take a chance at this rewarding opportunity!
 
Project Overview:

  • Experienced IT Program Manager to lead and manage IT projects in our AI program.
  • Possess deep expertise in IT project management, AI technologies, cloud platforms, and governance structures.
  • Responsible for ensuring the successful delivery of projects and use cases in this program by coordinating across teams, managing timelines, budgets, and resources, and maintaining alignment with organizational goals.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Oversee and manage projects, ensuring alignment with business and IT objectives and strategic goals.
  • Define program and project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.
  • Develop and manage detailed program and project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements and design solutions.
  • Ensure the seamless integration of AI models, data platforms, and other necessary components.
  • Monitor progress and manage any issues or risks that arise during the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate the RFP process, including going out to bid, evaluating proposals, and selecting the best solution.
  • Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to build, test, and implement the projects.
  • Support the establishment of an AI Center of Excellence (CoE) to drive AI strategy, standards, and best practices.
  • Engage with key stakeholders to gather requirements, provide updates, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Communicate program status, risks, and issues to senior management and other stakeholders.
  • Lead and mentor project teams, providing guidance and support to ensure successful project execution.
  • Foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment.
  • Develop and manage program budgets, ensuring efficient use of resources.
  • Monitor and control project expenditures to stay within budget.
  • Identify and manage program risks, developing mitigation strategies to address potential challenges.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, standards, and best practices.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process enhancements and implementing best practices.
 
Required Qualifications:
 
  • Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in IT project/program management, with a focus on AI and cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of Azure and AI technologies, including large language models and modern data platforms.
  • Experience with AI governance frameworks and AI Centers of Excellence.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 
Pay Rate: $60.00-$68.00/Hour
 
If hired, you will enjoy the following ECLARO Benefits:
  • 401k Retirement Savings Plan administered by Merrill Lynch
  • Commuter Check Pretax Commuter Benefits
  • Eligibility to purchase Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance through ECLARO

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant
Job Number: 26-01104

Do you want to work where innovation drives business? ECLARO is looking for a Senior Accountant for our client in Melville, NY.

ECLARO’s client ranks in the Top 5 Companies awarded US patents annually, and is known worldwide as a leader in the technology industry. If you’re up to the challenge, then take a chance at this rewarding opportunity!

Position Overview:
  • Senior level accounting position responsible for general ledger reconciliations, general ledger analysis and forecasting, assist with reserve valuations, develops procedures, tests account backup, and special projects as assigned.
  • Work schedules and office reporting requirements may change from time to time based on business needs.

Responsibilities:
  • Responsible for monthly account reconciliations, and analysis.
  • Responsible for balance sheet trend analysis and reporting.
  • Monitors assigned accounts for exposure, report concerns to manager.
  • Researches and corrects account discrepancies.
  • Tests ledger backup.
  • Participates in the month-end close.
  • Assists with transmission and reporting of financials.
  • Responsible for special projects, as required by management.
  • Assists with physical inventory and fixed asset audits.
  • Supports internal and use tax audits of fixed assets.
  • Assists other department members and managers with projects.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience, required, plus 5 years of related experience.
  • Working knowledge of GAAP including experience in and ability to research GAAP and other Authoritative Pronouncements.
  • Strong Excel skills.
  • CPA License is required.
  • Audit Experience with a large Regional and / or International Public Accounting Firm is preferred
  • Requires strong initiative.
  • Should be able to bring potential solution options to manager along with issues.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, time management and written skills.

Salary: $76,150.00 - $114,040.00 / Year
